card.name: The word Anyone starting a sentence
card.fires_on: The word "Anyone" (or "anyone") opening a new sentence or aside. It is strongest in antiepileptic and antidepressant labels, in the sentence "Anyone considering prescribing...", and also in rhetorical "anyone?" asides.

modes.label: Label warning sentence
modes.description: "Anyone" starts the sentence after the epilepsy or pediatric suicidality-risk statement, before "considering prescribing/the use of".

modes.label: Rhetorical aside
modes.description: "anyone?" tacked on after a comma in casual web text as a call for audience response.
modes.example: Hot Tamales,<< anyone>>? This year's San Jose Tamale

card.plain: It marks the word "Anyone" at the start of the sentence that tells readers who are considering prescribing the drug to weigh the risks.
